note: Every blocker below was re-read from its in-repo source before listing. Status vocabulary: BLOCKED_OWNER_DECISION (needs a written owner decision), BLOCKED_PRODUCTION_LOCK (needs production authorization), BLOCKED_SOURCE_EVIDENCE (needs verified source evidence before authoring). Doc wording changes never resolve a blocker. Owner-maintained files (OWNER_DECISIONS.json, OWNER_ACTION_REQUIRED.md, LICENSE_DECISION_RECORD.md) were NOT modified by this register.

blockers.title: License grant for original dataset content
blockers.affected: repository root (no LICENSE/COPYING file); docs/REQUIREMENTS_MATRIX.json licenseStatus (0 VERIFIED); README License TODO
blockers.why: No license grant exists; absence means all-rights-reserved by default (docs/LICENSE_DECISION_RECORD.md §1). The requirements-matrix validator tripwire fails if a license file appears without the grant commit updating this record
blockers.technicalImpact: none on tests/validators; blocks any reuse or redistribution claim
blockers.licenseImpact: highest: nothing (original or third-party) carries redistribution terms until decided
blockers.evidenceRequired: written owner choice of license(s) + grant file(s) commit
safeOptions: choose a data license (e.g. CC-BY-4.0) for original content and commit the grant file(s)
keep all-rights-reserved explicitly and document it
blockers.unblockAction: commit grant file(s) + update LICENSE_DECISION_RECORD.md §4 + flip matrix licenseStatus with evidence + update the validator tripwire

blockers.title: Per-source redistribution authorization (GHSA / OSV / NVD / CWE / original)
blockers.affected: docs/OWNER_DECISIONS.json (5 decisions, all OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED, decidedAt/decider null); vuln-intel/sources.json redistribution: UNVERIFIED; docs/REQUIREMENTS_MATRIX.json
blockers.why: Source URL / API access / SPDX id is not a grant (docs/LICENSE_DECISION_RECORD.md §2). sources.json licenseReview VERIFIED_ALLOWED is a terms-text review, not authorization (docs/PROVENANCE_POLICY.md §6)
blockers.technicalImpact: blocks production counting and release gates G6/G17
blockers.licenseImpact: third-party records remain BLOCKED_LICENSE_REVIEW; redistribution of GHSA/OSV/NVD content unauthorized
blockers.evidenceRequired: owner signature per source: which sources are redistributable and under what attribution; per-batch license-field resolution
safeOptions: authorize per source with attribution conditions (GHSA CC-BY-4.0 BY path is lay-reviewed)
authorize a subset and exclude the rest fail-closed
authorize none; keep the frozen seed internal
blockers.unblockAction: fill decidedAt/decider/status in docs/OWNER_DECISIONS.json per source + update sources.json redistribution + LICENSE_DECISION_RECORD.md

blockers.title: Production ingestion authorization (GATE-1 stage approval, GATE-3 reviewer capacity, GATE-4 provider design)
blockers.affected: docs/OWNER_ACTION_REQUIRED.md §2-§3; scripts/import-ghsa.mjs / import-osv.mjs (production mode exits 1 without gates); docs/RELEASE_READINESS_MATRIX.json G8
blockers.why: Production Intelligence Lock: no real catalog ingestion, no auto promotion; GATE-1 requires written stage approval naming stage/source/maintainer/license basis per source; GATE-3 requires named reviewers (no bulk unreviewed ingest); GATE-4 is app-workstream provider design
blockers.technicalImpact: importers stay dry-run/mocked; corpus stays at the frozen 100-record seed
blockers.evidenceRequired: written stage approval + reviewer capacity statement + provider design acceptance
safeOptions: grant stage approval for a named batch after BLK-002
keep the lock and continue synthetic rehearsals only
blockers.unblockAction: record GATE-1/3(/4) evidence; then run the staged fail-closed importer (dry-run first) with per-batch license resolution

blockers.title: Approval expiry / re-review cadence + corpus refresh cadence
blockers.why: No semantics exist yet for approval expiry or refresh cadence; until set, any approval is single-batch and non-extending
blockers.technicalImpact: none today; required before any multi-batch production run
blockers.productionImpact: without it, production approvals cannot compound
blockers.evidenceRequired: owner policy statement (expiry interval + refresh interval)
safeOptions: set explicit cadences (e.g. re-review every N months)
blockers.unblockAction: add cadence semantics to the ingestion protocol and gate checklist
